steps.message: Listen exactly once to Session clip clip-1 on track 1-808 Core Kit, scene 0, for durationBeats 4 using that track's existing listener and all six metric families. List the complete feature inventory, following pagination, and report its context ID, measure count, feature definitions/counts and grid dimensions. Read the original stored measurement report and derive canonical stored features for this new context if needed. Without capturing, deriving, editing or changing transport, read the two original stored contexts and their complete feature inventories from the preceding Session and Arrangement listens. Use includeHistorical=true where needed and follow pagination. Report original context/feature IDs, stored schema, measure counts, feature definitions/counts and grid dimensions. Do not compare numerical values or treat assistant text as proof. Stop immediately if an original context or inventory is missing or changed; do not repair, rederive or recapture.
